module: Data manager of the editor's Master Spline tool. It stores the list of Master Splines (nodes, widths, nmls, layers, geometry mode "engineered" with clothoids or "spline" Catmull-Rom, homologation), rebuilds the geometry of "dirty" splines, drives the linked layers (via layerMgr) and provides deep copies, serialization, split/join, undo/redo callbacks and grouped session save/load (masters + mesh/assembly/decal/road/tree children).
notes: Constants: tool prefix "Master Spline", edit mode key "masterSpline", minimum 10 subdivisions per segment, minimum import size of a path 10 m.

A Master Spline notably contains: name, id (UUID), isEnabled, isDirty, isLoop, isConformToTerrain, isAutoBanking, bankStrength, autoBankFalloff, geometryMode, engRadiusM, engTransM, engVertLenM, curveWidenMaxM, curveWidenRunoffM, corners, nodes, widths, nmls, secondary arrays (ribPoints, divPoints, divWidths, tangents, binormals, normals, discMap), layers, roadLength, splineAnalysisMode, homologationPreset, isOptimising and the eXxxNorm error arrays.

updateDirtyMasterSplines: with fewer than 2 nodes, the secondary geometry is cleared; in conform mode, the nodes are placed on the terrain; otherwise engineeredGeom.sampleInto, with Catmull-Rom fallback (conform, auto-banking or free).
Session load: new UUIDs are generated for all masters, children and layers; links whose child is not in the batch are removed.
addToMasterSplineArray does not update the id-to-index table (call recomputeIdMap afterwards).

Probable minor BUG: in convertPathsToMasterSplines, an empty Master Spline is created even for a path that is too small, and the log message computes "too small" as #paths - #masterSplines, which also counts pre-existing splines.

getMasterSplines.desc: Returns the array (live, not copied) of the Master Splines.

getIdToIdxMap.desc: Returns the id-to-index table of the Master Splines.

addNewMasterSpline.desc: Creates an empty Master Spline (engineered mode, unique name, UUID) and adds it to the list, then recomputes the id-to-index table.

name.desc: Base name; "Master Spline N" by default.

addToMasterSplineArray.desc: Adds a Master Spline to the list without recomputing the id-to-index table.

removeMasterSpline.desc: Deletes the Master Spline at index idx, all its layers and their linked splines, then recomputes the id-to-index table.

removeAllMasterSplines.desc: Deletes all the Master Splines of the session, with their layers and linked children.

updateDirtyMasterSplines.desc: Rebuilds the geometry of isDirty splines (terrain, engineered or Catmull-Rom, turn widening, rib points, homologation if enabled), updates the linked layers and roadLength. Non-dirty splines only update their dirty layers. Signals the modification to the session if anything was rebuilt.

isSplineAnalysisEnabled.desc: If true, runs homologation.analyseSpline on splines with more than 2 discretized points.

manageLiveOptimise.desc: If the selected spline has isOptimising true and more than 2 divPoints, runs homologation.optimiseSpline with the number of iterations per frame.

deepCopyMasterSpline.desc: Deep copy of a Master Spline (string.buffer).

deepCopyAllMasterSplines.desc: Deep copy of the whole list of Master Splines.

recomputeIdMap.desc: Recomputes the id-to-index table (called by the session wizard after a load).

captureLinkedSplinesState.desc: Deep copy of all the child splines linked by the layers of all the Master Splines, grouped by tool.

returns.desc: Table with the lists meshSpline, assemblySpline, decalSpline, roadSpline, treeSpline.

captureTransTierState.desc: Captures the full state for multi-spline undo/redo: Master Splines and linked splines.

splitMasterSpline.desc: Cuts the Master Spline at the chosen node. A loop becomes an open spline restarted at the cut point; otherwise two copies "name (1)" and "name (2)" are created with their turn overrides, and the layers are handled for each half.

splineIdx.desc: Index of the spline in the list.

joinMasterSplines.desc: Joins two open Master Splines: the first receives the concatenated geometry and the second is deleted. Does nothing if the indices are invalid.

convertPathsToMasterSplines.desc: Converts paths coming from a bitmap into Master Splines: grid points converted to world via the terrain editor, terrain normals; imports only if the smallest AABB dimension exceeds 10 m. Writes a log.

paths.desc: List of paths { points (x, y grid), widths }.

serializeMasterSpline.desc: Serializes a Master Spline into a JSON-safe table (nodes and normals as {x,y,z}, layers, parameters).

deserializeMasterSpline.desc: Rebuilds a Master Spline (vec3, layers, empty secondary geometry to be regenerated) from serialized data.

lightSplineUndo.desc: Undo of light modifications to a Master Spline: applies data.old.

lightSplineRedo.desc: Redo of light modifications: applies data.new.

singleMasterSplineEditUndo.desc: Undo of an edit of a single Master Spline (applies data.old).

singleMasterSplineEditRedo.desc: Redo of an edit of a single Master Spline (data.new); by default recreates the child splines deleted during the action, names and links the new ones.

transMasterSplineEditUndo.desc: Undo of a multi-spline edit (full state, masters and children).

undoLayerAdd.desc: Undo of a layer addition: removes the layer from the Master Spline (data.masterSplineId).

undoLayerRemove.desc: Undo of a layer deletion: restores it.

undoAddNewMasterSpline.desc: Undo of a Master Spline creation: deletes it by data.masterSplineId.

redoAddNewMasterSpline.desc: Redo of the creation: recreates a Master Spline with the id data.masterSplineId.

updateLinkedSplineName.desc: Renames the linked spline so that it follows the layer's name (via setNameJumpTable).

linkType.desc: Link type (tool prefix of the linked spline).

unlinkAllSplines.desc: Unlinks all the linked splines of the Master Spline (isLink = false, linkId = nil), without going through undo/redo.

serializeSessionState.desc: State for the shared session wizard: all the Master Splines plus each linked child (deduplicated by id), as JSON tables.

loadSessionState.desc: Loads a session state: new UUIDs for masters, children and layers, insertion of the children into their tools, relinking and dirty marking. Returns 0 if state is not a table.

replace.desc: If true, first deletes the whole current graph of masters (and their children).
